summary.headline: Mercury, Moon, and Saturn Aspects
summary.text: Astrological judgments for the trine and sextile of Mercury with Saturn and of the Moon with Saturn, covering marriage, markets, contracts, letters, scribes, weather, cold and snow, farming, building, messengers, and social harmony or discord.
